> "Within a firm consisting of 50 staff members, the management team makes up 20% of the total workforce. From this management team, only 30% are responsible for supervising the whole firm. How many staff members are in charge of supervising the entire firm?"

## Checking Each Step

**Step 1: Total staff** = 50 ✓

**Step 2: Management team**
$$20\% \times 50 = \frac{20}{100} \times 50 = 10 \text{ members}$$ ✓

**Step 3: Supervisors (30% of management team)**
$$30\% \times 10 = \frac{30}{100} \times 10 = 3 \text{ members}$$ ✓

## Final Answer

**3 staff members** are in charge of supervising the entire firm.
